entries.title: Terra Nil

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Terra Nil is an environmental strategy/city-building puzzle game released on March 28, 2023. Windows, iPhone, Android, iPad, and Nintendo Switch releases exist, and the official site advertises availability on Nintendo Switch, PC, and Netflix. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it gives the cleanest high-resolution capture and storefront patch path; the Netflix mobile and Switch versions are convenience routes without exclusive gameplay content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release. The Deluxe Edition contains soundtrack/artbook extras rather than required gameplay content, so the standard PC build is enough for the archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Steam/GOG availability and the strongest capture route.
